content.text: In regions where [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/[[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/payment-methods-filipino-digital-creators-every-detail-you-2|COREMERCH guide to payment]]-solutions-zimbabwean-digital-sellers-minimum-viable-stack|Payment Solutions]] platforms like Stripe and PayPal are inaccessible, [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/how-setting-up-nowpayments-digital-store-works-how-13|setting]] up a digital store can feel impossible. Countries like Nigeria, Kenya, and Venezuela often face barriers that limit online commerce. However, with COREMERCH's infrastructure, you can bypass these challenges entirely. This guide will walk you through deploying your digital store on Cloudflare Pages for free, utilizing Stack 02, which includes automatic crypto payment processing.
Why This Infrastructure Works When Platforms Fail

Traditional payment processors often lock out digital creators in emerging markets, stifling innovation and entrepreneurship. COREMERCH's infrastructure empowers you to take control. By utilizing decentralized payment solutions like NOWPayments and hosting platforms like Cloudflare Pages, you create an environment with no dependency on restrictive platforms. This sovereignty ensures that once your store is live, you control the entirety of your digital commerce without interference from third parties.
What You Need Before You Deploy

Before you begin your deployment, gather the essential components. You will need a Cloudflare account for hosting, a Supabase account for order management, and a NOWPayments account for processing crypto transactions. Additionally, prepare your digital products, such as ebooks or courses, and ensure they are ready for upload. Familiarize yourself with the Sovereign Blueprint, which outlines the deployment process in detail and will guide you through each step efficiently.
Setting Up Your Payment and Delivery Pipeline

Start by configuring your Supabase backend to manage orders and customer data. This step involves setting up tables to store product information and integrating payment processing with NOWPayments. Next, you will write the necessary backend logic using Cloudflare Workers to handle transactions and automate product delivery upon payment confirmation. This setup guarantees that your store operates smoothly, providing customers with instant access to their purchases.
Take control of your commerce with infrastructure that you own.
Going Live and Processing Your First Transaction

Once your backend and payment systems are configured, it’s time to test the setup. Deploy your Cloudflare Pages site, ensuring that all links to products are functional. Conduct a test transaction using NOWPayments to verify that the payment processing works as intended. Once you confirm that customers receive their products instantly after payment, your digital store is officially live and operational, ready for business.
Scaling Once the Infrastructure Is Running

After your store goes live, consider strategies for scaling. You can easily add more products to your Supabase database, expand your marketing efforts, and leverage social media to reach a larger audience. COREMERCH’s Edge Commerce Stack offers advanced features such as SPF/DKIM/DMARC email configuration, which can enhance your store’s credibility and customer trust. Always monitor performance metrics to ensure your infrastructure can handle increased traffic as your business grows.
How do I build a digital store that accepts crypto payments for free?

To build a digital store that accepts crypto payments for free, you can deploy on Cloudflare Pages using COREMERCH's Stack 02. This stack provides a fully operational store with crypto payment integration and instant product delivery. All components can be set up within 48 hours, ensuring you start selling quickly.
Scale your digital store without reliance on restrictive platforms.

Creators at the store setup stage comparing Stack 01 and Stack 02 are typically choosing between building it themselves with the Sovereign Blueprint at $47 — which covers both stacks in complete detail with full source code — or having COREMERCH deploy the complete Edge Stack under their accounts with the Edge Commerce Stack at $197. Both result in the same ownership structure: your GitHub or Cloudflare account, your Supabase database, your NOWPayments account, your wallet, your store. See both options at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

Follow the setup sequence without skipping steps — configuration errors are significantly harder to diagnose than setup time. First: create your NOWPayments account, add wallet addresses, generate your API key, and note your IPN secret key. Second: deploy the backend — configure Cloudflare Worker with your NOWPayments credentials and product settings, or configure Google Apps Script with the same — and confirm the endpoint URL. Third: set the webhook endpoint URL in your NOWPayments IPN settings. Fourth: deploy the storefront to Cloudflare Pages or GitHub Pages and confirm product pages and checkout display correctly. Fifth: configure your custom domain and DNS if using one. Sixth: complete a real mainnet test transaction. Seventh: check the order database for the test entry. Only after steps six and seven pass cleanly should you share the store URL publicly.

Stack 01 utilizes GitHub Pages and Apps Script for deployment, while Stack 02 leverages Cloudflare Pages, Workers, and Supabase. Stack 02 offers more robust features and is deployed by COREMERCH within 48 hours, fully tested before handoff.
Can I host a digital product store on GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages?

Yes, both GitHub Pages and Cloudflare Pages can host your digital product store. However, Cloudflare Pages combined with the full infrastructure of Stack 02 provides greater flexibility and performance for your store.
What cryptocurrencies can I accept with NOWPayments?
NOWPayments supports over 300 cryptocurrencies, allowing you to choose from a wide range of options for your customers. This flexibility enables you to cater to diverse payment preferences.
